theExchangeWillAlsoAppear: The exchange will also appear in Capture.
theFirstSendGetsThe: The first send gets the server's challenge; vscroxy answers it and sends again.
theHostTheSignatureCovers: The host the signature covers; a scheme and path are ignored.
theKeyValueBlockWrites: The Key: Value block writes every header value in plain text, including tokens, cookies and passwords. The table masks them one row at a time.
theRequestKeepsItsName: The request keeps its name, URL, Host header and SNI; the proxy dials the address instead.
theResponseBelowBelongsTo: The response below belongs to the previous send, not to this draft
theSavedOperationNoLonger: The saved operation no longer exists; Send uses the document's only operation
theSecretsGoToA: The secrets go to a file Wireshark reads (SSLKEYLOGFILE), so it can decrypt this capture. The engine reads the variable once, when it first handshakes, so a change here takes effect from the next launch.
theServerDidNotAdvertise: The server did not advertise tools, or the catalog has not loaded yet.
theServerDidNotAdvertise2: The server did not advertise resources or templates.
theServerDidNotAdvertise3: The server did not advertise prompts.
theSourceCaptureIsNo: The source capture is no longer in this session.
thisRunHasNoRecorded: This run has no recorded capture source.
thisSavedSessionContainsNo: This saved session contains no exchanges
thisSendSWireCapture: This send's wire capture is not available in this session. History may retain its snapshot.
thisStartsALocalCommand: This starts a local command with your user account. Only continue for a server you trust.
tokenLinkEvidenceIsBounded: Token-link evidence is bounded in memory (200 flows, 4 MiB); older or oversized captures are omitted. It is lost on restart, a new recording, or dismissing this status. Review never applies changes automatically.
tokenLinksSelected: {count} selected captures · JSON response → later Bearer Authorization · same origin only
tokenLinksSkipped: {count} responses were not inspected (non-JSON, incomplete, unavailable or outside analysis limits).
topicFiltersAcceptForOne: Topic filters accept + for one level and # for the remaining levels. Each row has its own QoS; MQTT 5 adds no-local, retain-as-published, retain handling (0 sends retained messages, 1 only for a new subscription, 2 never) and a subscription identifier.
totalSends: Total: {count, plural, one {# send} other {# sends}}.
traceLimitReachedSomeObservations: Trace limit reached · some observations were not retained
transportAppliesToSendAnd: TRANSPORT · applies to Send and the Collection Runner
uncheckedRowsStayHereAnd: Unchecked rows stay here and are not sent
unpinnedRequestsWillBeRemoved: Unpinned requests will be removed from this session. Export any traffic you want to keep first.
upstreamConnectionReusedPreviousSetup: Upstream connection reused · previous setup is not charged again
useIdForAWhole: Use :id for a whole path segment. Rename parameters here; literal segments are kept unchanged.
useNameInRequestsEnvironment: Use '{{name}}' in requests. Environment values override collection values and globals.
useVaultNameInA: Use '{{vault:name}}' in a URL, header, body or auth field. A secret with domains is sent only to those hosts.
usesTheFirstEffectiveServer: Uses the first effective server and required parameters. Body examples are copied when provided; schemas are not turned into invented payloads.
usesTheSystemRootsAnd: Uses the system roots and this app’s CA.
usingTheCollectionAndFolder: Using the collection and folder defaults.
utf8TextOrCanonical: UTF-8 text, or canonical padded base64 for binary · 1 MiB limit · opcode preserved
validationChecksOpenapiStructureNot: Validation checks OpenAPI structure, not whether your service implements the contract. No automatic or bidirectional synchronization is performed.
variablesAndVaultNameExpand: '{{variables}}' and '{{vault:name}}' expand on publish; text and json keep the text, hex ignores whitespace, base64 needs padding.
variablesAreReadOnlyClose: Variables are read-only. Close this dialog, repair or move env.json aside, then reload local assets.
variablesStayAsWrittenAnd: '{{variables}}' stay as written and scripts do not run; replace them before running the code.
viewRecordingScopeCountersAnd: View recording scope, counters and errors
waitingCancelledTheServerMay: Waiting cancelled. The server may still be processing; check whether sending again would repeat the operation.
waitingForResponseNoRequest: Waiting for response… · no request timeout
websocketSendsUseTheirOwn: WebSocket sends use their own TLS and timeout handling; these apply to HTTP(S) sends.
whatCaptureChangesOnThe: What capture changes on the way, and what the table shows.
whatThisRequestDoesIts: What this request does, its parameters and responses
whereVscroxyListensAndWhere: Where vscroxy listens, and where requests go next.
wireEvidenceNotCurrentRules: Wire evidence, not current rules. Redirect hops stay separate; source comparison uses the client result.
writeNonSensitiveCurrentValues: Write non-sensitive Current values into Initial; credentials stay local
writesTheInitialValuesShown: Writes the Initial values shown here, saved or not, in Postman's environment format; Current values are excluded
